verdict_reason: Correct, well-named RS256 test key and token helper shared by both tests that need it; one Major house-rule breach: two single-use literals at module scope.

todos.issue: RSA_MODULUS_BITS (line 5) and TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS (line 6) sit at module scope, but each is used by one function only (generateSigningKey line 10, signToken line 27) and neither is exported for a test to import; the house rule puts a literal used by one function inside that function.
todos.fix: Must: each literal lives in the one function that uses it, and module scope holds no constant used by a single function. One way: move RSA_MODULUS_BITS into generateSigningKey and TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS into signToken as local consts.
